main_text.head: Singularis Numerus.
main_text.l: G. שֶׁלּוֹ schellô,ipsius. Affixum } o cū nominibus Ejus, הוּ hu cum verbis Eum.
main_text.head: Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.l: N. הֵם hem & הֵמָּה hémma,ipsi. Af-fixum ם Mem cum nominibus Eorum: cum verbis Eos: Et הֵם hem,cum solis no-minibus pluralibus Eorum.

page.notes: Hebrew at the start of the first line is cut by the page edge; read as far as visible, marked [?]. The sign before "Affixum" is a brace joining "o" and "cū" to the line above.
